scenario: A file-global constant (LGRA.4.1) is referenced in a `where`: a constant lives in the value namespace (LGRA.4.4), so the reference resolves and the rule compiles. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: `compile_ok` does not observe whether the value is inlined.
rules_ds:
const Threshold = 75

schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig t where t.v > Threshold
->
    log info "x"
